groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Five boxes — P, Q, R, S, and T — are stacked one above the other from Position 1 (bottom) to Position 5 (top). Only one box occupies each position.

• Box Q is at the top.
• Box T is at the bottom.
• Box P is immediately above Box T.
• Box S is immediately below Box Q.
• Box R is placed between Box P and Box S (not adjacent to either).

questions.text: Which box is placed at Position 3?
questions.explanation: Step 1: Box T is at the bottom → Position 1.

questions.text: How many boxes are placed between Box T and Box Q?
questions.explanation: Box T is at Position 1 and Box Q is at Position 5.

groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Five boxes — Box A, Box B, Box C, Box D, and Box E — are stacked from Position 1 (bottom) to Position 5 (top). Each box is of a different colour: Blue, Red, Green, Yellow, and White.

• Box E is at the top and is Red.
• Box A is immediately below Box E and is Green.
• Box C is at the bottom and is Yellow.
• Box D is immediately above Box C and is Blue.
• Box B is placed between Box D and Box A and is White.

Refer to diagram: SVG/Q3.svg

questions.text: Which box is placed at Position 3?
questions.explanation: Step 1: Box C (Yellow) is at Position 1. Box D (Blue) is immediately above C → D at Position 2.

questions.text: What colour is the box placed at Position 2?
questions.explanation: From the arrangement: Position 2 = Box D, and Box D is Blue.

questions.text: How many boxes are placed above Box B?
questions.explanation: Box B is at Position 3. Boxes above Position 3: Box A (Position 4) and Box E (Position 5) → 2 boxes.

groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Six boxes — J, K, L, M, N, and O — are stacked from Position 1 (bottom) to Position 6 (top). Each box contains a different item: Book, Pen, Ruler, Eraser, Pencil, and Sharpener.

• Box O is at Position 1 and contains an Eraser.
• Box M is at Position 2 and contains a Pencil.
• Box J is at Position 3 and contains a Ruler.
• Box K is immediately above Box J and contains a Book.
• Box L is at the top and contains a Pen.
• Box N is immediately below Box L and contains a Sharpener.

Refer to diagram: SVG/Q6.svg

questions.text: Which box is placed at Position 5?
questions.explanation: Step 1: O(1), M(2), J(3) are directly given.

questions.text: What item does Box K contain?
questions.explanation: Box K is at Position 4 and contains a Book (stated in the clues).
Box L is at Position 6 (top) and contains the Pen (as given in clues).

questions.text: How many boxes are placed between Box M and Box L?
questions.explanation: Box M is at Position 2; Box L is at Position 6.

questions.text: Eight boxes are stacked from Position 1 (bottom) to Position 8 (top). Box W is placed exactly 3 positions above Box X. Box X is at Position 2. Box Y is placed immediately above Box W. Which position does Box Y occupy?
questions.explanation: Step 1: Box X is at Position 2.

groups.directions:
Read the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Seven boxes — A, B, C, D, E, F, and G — are stacked from Position 1 (bottom) to Position 7 (top). Each box contains a different fruit: Apple, Mango, Banana, Orange, Grapes, Papaya, and Guava.

• Box G is at the top and contains Apple.
• Box A is at Position 1 and contains Mango.
• Box F is immediately below Box G and contains Grapes.
• Box B is at Position 4 and contains Papaya.
• Box C is immediately above Box A and contains Orange.
• Box E is immediately below Box B and contains Banana.
• Box D is immediately below Box F and contains Guava.

Refer to diagram: SVG/Q11.svg

questions.text: Which box is placed at Position 5?
questions.explanation: Step 1: A at Position 1. C immediately above A → C at Position 2.

questions.text: Which fruit is contained in Box C?
questions.explanation: Box C is at Position 2 (immediately above Box A) and contains Orange, as stated in the clues.

questions.text: How many boxes are placed between Box E and Box G?
questions.explanation: Box E is at Position 3; Box G is at Position 7.

questions.text: Which box is placed immediately above Box D?
questions.explanation: Box D is at Position 5. The box at Position 6 (immediately above) is Box F.

questions.text:
Eight boxes are stacked from Position 1 (bottom) to Position 8 (top). The weights of the boxes are 10 kg, 15 kg, 20 kg, 25 kg, 30 kg, 35 kg, 40 kg, and 45 kg (each weight used exactly once).

• The 10 kg box is at Position 1.
• The 15 kg box is immediately above the 10 kg box.
• The 20 kg box is at Position 3.
• The 35 kg box is at Position 4.
• The 30 kg box is at Position 5.
• The 25 kg box is immediately above the 30 kg box.
• The 45 kg box is at Position 8.
• The 40 kg box is immediately below the 45 kg box.

If the boxes at Positions 3 to 6 are rearranged such that the heaviest box among them is placed at Position 3 and the lightest is placed at Position 6 (weights decreasing upward within this range), what will be the weight of the box at Position 4 after rearrangement?
